candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in inventory, causing inventory /v1/reservations 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; gateway p95 checkout latency ~2425ms matches the ~2s dependency timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded; cannot confirm whether timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or config.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory propagating to order ReadTimeout and gateway checkout 502s, consistent with the redis-timeout taxonomy. Gateway metrics show 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms. Redis-side evidence is unavailable, so the bounded candidate is offered with residual uncertainty.
